fonts.import_instructions: Import these fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@400;600;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;700&display=swap');

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-semibold text-primary

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Glassmorphism' for the sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px border-white/40). Use 'Flat Solid' for plant cards with a subtle 1px border (#D5DCC4) and soft ambient shadow.
visual_enhancers.effects: Interactive background effect that follows the visitor as they scroll. Implement a lightweight parallax effect using Framer Motion (useScroll and useTransform) mapped to CSS translations. Keep it extremely performant (low DOM node count) to 'Optimize for low-spec devices'. Use SVG organic leaf blobs.

grids.lobby: MODE A: The Bento Grid. Use an asymmetrical bento layout for the 6 plant cards to make the lobby feel like a botanical gallery. Mix col-span-1 and col-span-2 on larger screens. Use gap-8.

layouts.container: Generous spacing. Use max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-12.
layouts.sections: Padding py-24 or py-32 for breathing room.
layouts.cards: Internal padding p-8. Image max-h-[40vh] object-cover.

motion.interactions: Hover states on plant cards: subtle upward translation (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase. Image inside card slightly scales up on hover.
motion.page_transitions: Fade-in entrance animations staggered for lists using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast by using bg-black/40 overlay or text-shadow.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the parallax scroll effect.

media.icons: Use lucide-react (Leaf, Info, Sun, Droplets) to maintain clean and modern botanical aesthetic.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Avoid heavy 3D WebGL (like R3F) to strictly optimize for low-spec devices. Rely solely on 2D parallax and framer-motion.

instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be strictly in Indonesian.
Prominently display 'Made by C# group' or 'Dibuat oleh C# group' in the footer.
Lobby/Home page must display 6 plant sections as cards. Link them to their detail pages using react-router-dom.

Generate comprehensive, accurate Indonesian text for each plant: general description (Deskripsi Umum), scientific classification table (Klasifikasi Ilmiah), benefits/nutrition (Manfaat & Nutrisi), and planting & care guide (Panduan Penanaman & Perawatan).

Implement the interactive scroll-following background effect using Framer Motion (`useScroll` and `useTransform`), mapping scroll progress to the translation of light green background decorative elements. Use very few DOM nodes to optimize for low-spec devices.
Plant detail pages should have a large Hero photo. Use bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast for the plant name.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the sticky header or dropdowns. Use glassmorphism.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js`.
